evals.prompt: Restructure this Taskfile to follow idiomatic go-task conventions.
evals.expected_output: A restructured Taskfile where the duplicated build command and repeated version string are factored into variables and task reuse, every task has a description, and the file remains a valid version 3 Taskfile.
expectations: The version string 1.4.2 appears only once, defined as a variable, instead of being repeated across commands
The duplicated go build command is eliminated — release reuses the build task (via deps or a task: call) rather than repeating its command
The app name and output path are defined as variables rather than hardcoded in each command
Every task has a desc so it appears in task --list
The result is valid YAML that keeps version: '3'

evals.prompt: Write a Taskfile.yaml for a Go project with build, test, and lint tasks. Build should skip when nothing has changed.
evals.expected_output: A valid version 3 Taskfile with described build, test, and lint tasks, a default task, and change detection on build via sources and generates.
expectations: The file declares version: '3' and is valid YAML
build, test, and lint tasks all exist and each has a desc
The build task declares sources and generates (or an equivalent status check) so it is skipped when nothing changed
A default task is defined so running task with no arguments performs a sensible operation
